app_info.subtitle: Find tech jobs
app_info.description: RadarJobs connects to a user's existing account to search current U.S. technology jobs, manage named search workspaces shared with RadarJobs on the web, inspect one selected job, and review personalized recommendations. Results include normalized employment details, source evidence, freshness, the actual source posting, and a separate RadarJobs detail link.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing RadarJobs inventory but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries bounded RadarJobs inventory and returns stored provider source-posting URLs plus fixed-origin RadarJobs detail URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter jobs, submit applications, send messages, or change subscriptions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the account's existing recommendation set but records bounded operational usage telemetry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses recommendations already held within the authenticated RadarJobs account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not upload a resume, change profile data, submit applications, or modify access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one eligible opportunity but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads one bounded RadarJobs record and returns its stored provider source-posting URL plus the fixed-origin RadarJobs detail URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not save, apply to, update, or remove the selected job.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates one named search workspace in the connected RadarJobs account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores only user-supplied search constraints inside RadarJobs and returns a fixed-origin RadarJobs management URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not submit applications, contact employers, send alerts, or change billing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the connected account's named search workspaces but records bounded operational usage telemetry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses search criteria already stored within the authenticated RadarJobs account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter a workspace or any job, application, alert, or subscription.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs existing saved criteria and records bounded last-run and result-count state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries bounded RadarJobs inventory and returns stored provider source-posting URLs plus fixed-origin RadarJobs detail URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not apply, message, purchase, or send an alert.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the name, filters, or active state of one user-selected RadarJobs search workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores only user-supplied search constraints inside the connected RadarJobs account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Pause and resume are reversible; the tool does not delete searches, jobs, applications, or account data.

test_cases.description: Search current U.S. technology jobs without imposing a contract filter.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find five current remote data engineering jobs in the United States.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls search directly and returns up to five current technology jobs across eligible employment types, with employment details, pay when known, source posting links, and RadarJobs detail links.

test_cases.description: Preserve RadarJobs' deep contract filters within the broader tech inventory.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find current remote AI engineer work that allows C2C.
test_cases.expected_output: Passes ordinary role wording directly to search, preserves the C2C and remote constraints, and presents the returned classifications without editorial re-validation.

test_cases.description: Read the connected account's complete existing personalized recommendations.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my complete current RadarJobs recommendations in ranked order.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the existing ranked personalized recommendation set without starting checkout or calling search or per-result detail tools.

test_cases.description: Inspect one eligible technology job identified by RadarJobs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me more about the first RadarJobs result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current bounded detail for the selected opportunity with employment information, supporting evidence, the actual source-posting URL, and the RadarJobs detail URL.

test_cases.description: Return a complete zero-result answer without retrying or silently relaxing filters.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find current remote quantum COBOL compiler jobs paying at least $900 per hour.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls search once, reports the complete exact-match result, and asks which one constraint the user wants to broaden without invoking another tool.

test_cases.description: Create a named search workspace shared with RadarJobs on the web.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save a search called Remote data engineering for remote U.S. data engineer jobs posted in the last three days.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one active named workspace with the exact stated role, remote, country, and freshness constraints and returns its RadarJobs management link.

test_cases.description: List and run an existing named search workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my saved RadarJobs searches and run Remote data engineering.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists account-owned workspaces, identifies the requested active workspace, and returns up to five current jobs using its exact saved constraints.

test_cases.description: Pause one identified workspace without changing its filters.
test_cases.user_prompt: Pause my Remote data engineering search.
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the named workspace and changes only its state to paused.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs for non-technology employment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a registered nurse position.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because the request is outside technology work.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs to edit a resume.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite the experience section of my resume.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because it does not edit or process resumes through this plugin.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs for purchases or job applications.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy a RadarJobs subscription and apply to the first job for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because the plugin cannot purchase access, change subscriptions, or submit job applications.
